The **Alien Blaster** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

An energy weapon that uses Alien Blaster Rounds. A Fusion Magazine mod can be used to convert the weapon to shoot the more common Fusion Cells but will also reduce the damage output and ammo capacity.
